svg.title: Enterprise RAG OS — Retrieval-augmented generation and Groq workflows.
svg.desc: Project card 5 of 6. Enterprise RAG OS: Chunks and embeds documents into ChromaDB, retrieves top-k context and answers with LLaMA 3 via Groq. Stack: ChromaDB, Groq, LLaMA 3, Jupyter. Opens the source repository on GitHub.
